findings.note_span: GP review in 4 weeks for inhaler review and asthma action plan.
findings.transcript_evidence: I want you to see your GP or asthma nurse within two working days, to review your inhalers and make an asthma action plan.
findings.rationale: The note specifies a 4-week follow-up, but the transcript indicates a much shorter follow-up period of two working days.
